title: Efficiencies of pumps to be adopted for design purposes
rows: Horizontal foot mounted centrifugal pump sets
markdown:
| No. | Type of Pump Set | Efficiency |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Horizontal foot mounted centrifugal pump sets | 0.85 |
| 2 | Vertical shaft centrifugal pump sets | 0.8 |
| 3 | Submersible pump sets | 0.65 |
| 4 | Positive displacement pump sets | 0.40 |
notes: In actual practice based on the manufacturer’s pump curves and duty point, the figures may vary and here again, the figures will vary from manufacturer to manufacturer and hence, suffice to state that for design purposes, these figures shall be used.
